sections.heading: Best way to reach us
sections.body: WhatsApp is the fastest channel for questions, availability, and coordination. For formal invoices or referrals, email works too.

sections.heading: Hours
sections.note: By appointment. I don't sit in the clinic all day: we schedule what works for you.

sections.heading: Location and access
sections.body: Ometz Dental — Barrio Mburucuyá, Asunción, Paraguay. Exact street address will be shared when you book your appointment. We're a 2-minute walk from the main Mburucuyá plaza; access and parking guidance sent at booking.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.body: New patients accepted. Soft launch: mid-July 2026. First appointments are typically available within one to two weeks of the opening.
